1_port_responses.consequence: sum_p P_p = 4 on the triplet, sum_p Q_p = 6 on the doublet; sum_p dGamma(E_p) = 4 N3 + 6 N2
1_port_responses.joint kernel: the empty pattern only (one zero singular value; exact argument: positivity and the sum rule)

3_cover_action.reading: the five face positions carry the regular representation of the stabilizer (trace 0, central element +1); the five levels carry triplet + spinor doublet (trace nonzero, central element -1 on two levels): no equivariant renaming

4_port_gauge_transformations.consequence: a Gauss-positive codeword (uniform superposition over the star orbit of a word with a given flux pair) is fixed by each of the twelve star operators: eigenvalue +1 at every port, for all 190 pairs and for the flat word

candidates.a quantum: charged: Z2 = n2 mod 2 and the weights of its pattern (Q6 = 3 n2 - 2 n3); 30 of 32 patterns have Q6 != 0, 16 are Z2-odd
candidates.b flux pair of a carrier: neutral: no quantum, annihilated by all twelve lifted port responses and by every native current; central element +1; star operators +1. It carries the frame characters (55, 45, 45, 45) and its separation class
candidates.c composite: the charges of its quantum; the flux pair adds a neutral label
candidates.d plaquette flux between carriers: neutral: a function of the Z of the links, commutes with every G_x
